name: Sufferings
overview: Scripture reveals that sufferings in this present time, though real and challenging, are temporary and incomparable to the eternal glory that awaits believers (Romans 8:18). Christians are called to find joy even in trials, recognizing them as opportunities for spiritual growth and perseverance (James 1:2). This hope is anchored in the finished work of Christ, who bore our sins and will return to bring salvation without sin (Hebrews 9:28). Ultimately, God promises a future where pain, sorrow, and death will be completely removed, affirming the believer's peace through faith in Jesus Christ (Romans 5:1; Revelation 21:4).
